channel.title: Alabama Political Reporter - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Alabama Political Reporter (alreporter.com)

item.title: Opinion | The things we leave behind
item.description: Everything on earth will rust or rot, and that’s what will happen to most of the stuff you covet today.

item.title: Gov. Ivey signs bill requiring English proficiency for truck drivers
item.description: Governor Kay Ivey signed legislation Wednesday requiring commercial drivers to prove federal work authorization and English proficiency to enhance Alabama highway safety.

item.title: Lockheed Martin to invest in Pike County production facility
item.description: Lockheed Martin signed an incentive agreement with Alabama to invest $150 million and create new jobs at its Pike County facility.

item.title: Changing the Course Art Show highlights prison arts, reentry programs in Alabama
item.description: State leaders gathered Tuesday to celebrate inmate-created artwork and new legislative efforts designed to streamline workforce reentry for formerly incarcerated Alabamians.

item.title: Alabama Senate Judiciary Committee holds public hearing on prison oversight legislation
item.description: Proponents shared stories of corruption and deplorable conditions Wednesday during a hearing on a bill to establish an independent office to monitor Alabama prisons.

item.title: Bill to restrict discussion of contraceptives in sex ed faces pushback in public hearing
item.description: “Bills like this don’t create jobs. They don’t raise wages. And they don’t make our state more competitive,” one speaker said.

item.title: Lawmakers review Education Trust Fund as reserves decline
item.description: Lawmakers warned that reserves are declining as revenue growth remains steady while debating education initiatives and rising costs.

item.title: Bill to pause new solar developments advances to Alabama Senate for vote
item.description: The Alabama Senate Transportation and Energy Committee advanced bills including a one-year moratorium on large-scale solar projects on Wednesday.

item.title: Bill to close Alabama primaries takes first step toward becoming law
item.description: Supporters believe each party should choose its own candidates while opponents argue the bill disenfranchises voters.

item.title: Bill Britt warns that democracy cannot survive competing realities
item.description: Bill Britt examines the erosion of shared truth, arguing that democracy cannot survive when citizens live in competing versions of reality.
